cost: Current diagnosis: cached JSON only, zero PDF/OCR/model/network calls. Production full digital re-acquisition estimate from recorded dev3 635s plus WEF2667s, about55min; real6 added digital cost unmeasured; zero new OCR permitted.
decision: Retype a table-kind block as figure, non-citable, iff inside its bbox a variable-length aligned parallel-bar cluster OR dense large cubic curves with axes, numeric-label rows and repeated compact swatches exists, and neither ruled-cell grid nor aligned repeated-cell rectangle matrix exists. No identifiers, page thresholds, or document constants. Default preserve; missing native objects UNKNOWN. Chart numbers never verifiable.
execution: Diagnostic can run on Part1 saved native-object evidence. Canonical reading snapshots lack these primitives; production adoption needs reader-level native object capture and fingerprint/cache decision with G-R1/G-R2. No such change approved.
implementation_files: matn_reading/pdf_objects.py or an explicitly chosen native-object transport
focused reading tests only after named implementation approval
inputs: native chars with font size and positions
measurement_limits: Numeric-label rows are a geometric signal, not numbers extracted as evidence.
Legend candidates lack color in the saved native-object schema; compact geometry only.
All new relative thresholds are hypotheses fixed before this check, not calibrated estimates; an empirical optimal-value claim is not supported.
Raster image content is not classified; no OCR/model/image-labeler call.
Partial-chart block bounding boxes can omit required plot primitives.
Prior Part1 inspection means reused annotations are not an independent unseen population test.
name: M1 general object rule v1

alignment_em.evidence: Existing reader uses 0.1-em gap scale; reuse as geometric alignment tolerance, not measured chart accuracy.

bar_max_thickness_em.evidence: 2 em excludes full text-cell/paragraph shading from slender-bar candidates; hypothesis.

bar_min_aspect.evidence: 3:1 defines a slender bar rather than a compact legend swatch; structural hypothesis, not annotation-tuned.

bar_min_thickness_em.evidence: 0.2 em keeps visible filled marks above thin strokes; hypothesis expressed in local font scale.

bar_thickness_relative_tolerance.evidence: 20% accommodates drawing rounding while requiring repeated mark thickness; hypothesis.

cell_min_columns.evidence: Two disjoint columns are required for a rectangular cell matrix; topology.

cell_min_common_rows.evidence: Three repeated aligned rows distinguish a matrix from two headers; structural hypothesis.

curve_min_extent_em.evidence: 2 em excludes normal glyph-size cubic outlines; structural hypothesis.

curve_min_objects.evidence: 12 reuses existing VECTOR_REGION_MIN_OBJECTS to demand a dense drawing, not an isolated curve.

grid_min_columns.evidence: Three column boundaries define at least two cells; topology.

grid_min_intersections.evidence: 3 x 3 intersections for the ruled-cell-grid veto; topology.

grid_min_rows.evidence: Three distinct row boundaries define at least two cells; topology, not document position.

grid_min_span_share.evidence: 0.5 retains the existing figure/table overlap majority principle as minimum grid-line span.

legend_max_extent_em.evidence: 2 em is the compact-mark complement of the large-curve filter; hypothesis.

legend_min_aspect.evidence: 0.5 and 2 bracket compact swatches rather than elongated bars; reciprocal geometric definition.

legend_min_swatches.evidence: Two series swatches demand repeated legend structure; topology.

min_bar_count.evidence: Three repeated objects is the existing VECTOR_CELL_MIN_OBJECTS; two can be decoration.

min_length_range_em.evidence: One em of changing length distinguishes measured bars from equal-width cell shading; hypothesis.

min_parallel_row_separation_em.evidence: 0.2 em separates rows instead of counting overdraw of one mark; hypothesis.

test_expectations: No existing expectations changed now. Future classified chart/table fixtures and structure/citability counts require named rule approval; frozen targets remain unchanged; no proposed expected-value edits to existing tests.
